title: thumb MCP
tagline: Warm, playful and beat-cut: a pixel mascot, a pill carousel and on-device demos for a developer tool.
description: The launch film for thumb, the open-source iPhone MCP for Claude. A pixel-art thumb mascot, a carousel of things to ask Claude, search and Figma demos on a phone, a settings walkthrough and an install command — every scene starts on a downbeat of the track, with the effects mixed over it. Built for developer tools and AI products that want to feel friendly rather than corporate.
